thread:
maria: kicking off migration for feature/tenant_flags -> add tenant_flags.v2 JSONB column. change window 02:00-03:30 UTC. tagging @sam @alex for DB ops and rollback owner.

alex: noted. canary cluster scheduled at 02:05. will watch lock metrics and replica lag.

deploybot: deploybot: migration job scheduled: mig_2026_11_02_tflags_v2 on worker-gpu-3. ETA 02:00 UTC. will auto-pause on >30s exclusive lock or >20% replica lag.

sam: quick q — backfill strategy is async small-batch, rate=5000 rows/min, tolerate eventual consistency for 15m, right?

maria: yes. small-batch with resume points. if we hit >1s p99 on write path we abort. see release notes PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/relnotes/pull/421

tess: adding note to release notes: "tenant_flags v2 additive column + backfill; opt-in flag for 24h". cc @maria

alex: preflight run on staging shows median lock hold ~120ms for ALTER with our PG settings. should be fine but watch long transactions.

deploybot: canary started (02:05:12). applying DDL: ALTER TABLE tenant_flags ADD COLUMN v2 jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;

srebot: alert: deploybot-mig_2026_11_02_tflags_v2 observed exclusive_lock_duration=34s on shard-4 at 02:07:21. automated pause triggered.

sam: thanks for the auto-pause. what caused the long lock? any big transactions?

alex: looking at pg_stat_activity — bulk ingest from analytics job overlapped. I marked analytics job in maintenance window as mis-scheduled. killing that transaction now (manual kill).

maria: killing okay, but we need a safe unblock checklist: 1) confirm kill succeeded 2) verify replica lag <5s 3) run a single ALTER retry on canary shard 4) monitor p99 write latency for 5m 5) if all good, resume global apply with staggered shards. agree?

tess: +1 on checklist. also update release notes with a short rollback blurb in case we need to revert column addition.

alex: kill succeeded, replica lag 2s. running ALTER retry on canary shard now.

deploybot: manual unblock requested by alex. holdpoints: operator=alex, reason="cleared conflicting tx". proceeding to retry on shard-4.

deploybot: ALTER retry completed on shard-4 at 02:12:40. duration 180ms. p99 write latency spike 0.6s (within threshold).

maria: looks good. Sam, start staggered rollout: shards 1-4 -> wait 5m -> 5-8 -> wait 5m -> remainder. set backfill rate to 2.5k/min for first 10m.

sam: started shard wave-1. paused monitoring in #eng-oncall and will post cadence updates.

srebot: note: automatic fallback policy active. if any shard pause >90s or exclusive_lock >25s, deploybot will stop and notify.

tess: documenting the rollback procedure: revert DDL script is `ALTER TABLE tenant_flags DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS v2;` and backfill resume is a no-op if not fully applied. Adding to runbook.

maria: decision: do not pin API version; client reads tolerate v2 absent. we will toggle feature flag once backfill reaches 95% rows. pinning only if rollback needed.

alex: wave-1 done. no additional pauses. proceeding with wave-2.

sam: wave-2 done. backfill progress: 48% complete. adjusting rate to 4k/min.

maria: good. keep eyes on long-tail locks, but if everything stays healthy we can mark migration complete at 03:10 UTC and publish release notes final.

deploybot: migration job completed: 97% rows backfilled due to a small reserved tenant that needs manual copy. created follow-up ticket #INC-7421.

tess: releasing notes update: migration complete, follow-up ticket for edge tenant. publishing in ~10m. :party_parrot:

maria: moving to close. if any rollback needed, procedure and owners are in the thread above. thanks everyone for quick responses.
